name: Hatsu Date to Hatsu Ecchi ~Yuuenchi Hen
original_name: 初でーと初えっち～遊園地編
source:
Enjoy a day at the theme park with very young, innocent Nanaumi-chan. It's her first time! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094390.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
和年幼、天真的七海一起在遊樂園度過一天。這是她的第一次！
